entities.summary: Tidra is an offshore island 29 kilometres long and 8 km (5 mi) wide. It is the largest island off the shore of Banc d' Arguin, Mauritania and is home to a community of Imraguen fishing tribe. The island is part of the Banc d'Arguin National Park.
